text.text_337bc59a3d578cfc: Hillsboro Civic Theater began with a question: Why not build a theater that reflects our city? Live shows bring people together. They help us feel, connect, and see the world in new ways.
text.text_8354393894304622: We believe big musicals can change lives, both in the audience and on stage. Our shows bring together live orchestras, great sets, and a volunteer cast and crew. Each costume, note, and light takes care. We give that care freely to make something together.
text.text_c482fef5b8dc5a4a: We are taking the time to build HCT with care. Before our first show, we are finding the people, funds, and tools we need. We want to be ready when the curtain rises.
text.text_e62c2670bc439f6a: To bring big musicals to life with local volunteers. To create shows that move people and welcome all of Hillsboro.
text.text_c37189f0461ff8dd: A city where live theater is part of life. A place where people from all walks of life belong, create, and share the joy of a show.
text.text_97cd3a1f18a04a6b: A theater that takes care of its people.
text.text_86be3c5c7d57c839: HCT is here for that moment. And for everyone who wants to help make it happen.
text.text_be81d2d1bfc90c3b: Volunteers fill every role at HCT. Give your time and help build a theater for Hillsboro.
text.text_98a00d8fd207a593: Find the level that's right for you.
text.text_21206a31c4069412: You can give supplies, tools, services, or skills. These gifts matter as much as money. Have something to offer? Let’s talk.
text.text_fa54dbc329c26389: Your business can help HCT get started. Become a sponsor and be part of our story.
text.text_6b9ed6946bf3fb0e: You can leave a gift to HCT in your will or estate plan. Help keep the arts alive in Hillsboro for years to come.
text.text_f224d9caec59ee60: There are many ways to help HCT.
text.text_3137a7f3330c8349: HCT is just getting started. We are planning how it will run, building local ties, and bringing volunteers together. Your help brings great theater closer to our stage.
text.text_b47718a33a9ba39f: Volunteers run HCT. Your gift supports the orchestra, costumes, sets, and lights. It never pays salaries. When you give now, you help build the theater before our first show or ticket sale.
text.text_bb7c8260381290dc: Our community will help bring every show to life. From the first note to the final bow, your support makes it possible.
text.text_f3e06f4cc8203953: We are bringing our first cast and orchestra together now. Auditions and rehearsals are still ahead.
text.text_5954495478596cf4: Sing, act, dance, or play an instrument? Tell us you want to join our first shows. You'll be among the first to hear about auditions.
text.text_151650d0a904814e: All roles on stage and in the orchestra are unpaid. Everyone at HCT is a volunteer. We come for the work, the people, and the moment the lights come up.
text.text_f78eb95a4a8ff5d1: We're building this together. Right now. From the ground up.
text.text_f4ace222ffb8b464: Hillsboro Civic Theater is just getting started. We don't have a venue of our own yet. We haven't cast our first show or raised our first curtain.
text.text_27e0a85f93bc3581: We have a clear goal and people who care. More people are joining us because they believe this is worth building.
text.text_12018e32fc7abbf2: We need founding sponsors at every level, from neighbors to local businesses. We need performers, musicians, directors, and crew for our first shows. We are building a team of volunteers and local partners to help HCT thrive for years to come.
text.text_8abb6aa01b50b772: There is so much ahead of us. Come help shape it.
text.text_4454d7ea2909e35d: Help build a future for live theater in Hillsboro. We welcome sponsors at every level. We will thank our sponsors in founding materials, our first season program, at shows, and in HCT's history.
text.text_58241309810fdee5: Businesses can give funds, goods, or services. We can build a sponsor package to fit your goals and budget.
text.text_e8969f3835c5ec18: HCT needs help on stage and behind the scenes. Plan events, spread the word, or help in the office. You can design, take photos, or raise funds. Bring your skills or just a wish to help. We want to hear from you.
text.text_9c81b93ad9b4bd34: We need performers, musicians, designers, builders, donors, and dreamers to help us get started. Our first curtain is still ahead. We want you here when it rises.
text.text_c36cb903e18b1731: A new theater is taking shape in Hillsboro. Local volunteers build and run it. If you love the thrill of a live show, you belong here.
text.text_94f0c4342ec3cfb1: Get the first news about auditions, tickets, and what comes next.
text.text_61ebd65983b413c0: Local volunteers are building Hillsboro Civic Theater from the ground up. We love live shows and want to bring something special to our city. Our musicals have a full live orchestra. We want every show to stay with you long after the lights go down.
text.text_9b68fc80ce812493: Every performer, musician, and crew member gives their time for free. We bring our skills, care, and love of theater to each show.
text.text_9bfc7ed658ff8107: © 2025 Hillsboro Civic Theater. A community nonprofit theater.
text.text_3e5f953ad884a92d: We believe Hillsboro deserves great live theater. HCT is built and run by the volunteers who call this place home.
text.text_62aeae0680b6c54f: Ready to help us build this?
text.text_0e4f07efd84cc1ba: Give, volunteer, perform, or spread the word. Every bit of help brings HCT closer to the stage.
text.text_e0b1dbf20a65a448: The people of Hillsboro are building HCT for everyone to enjoy. On stage, in the orchestra, behind the scenes, or in the audience, you help bring it to life.
text.text_3302bc1ea6bdc918: We're bringing our first team together. Fill out the form below. We'll be in touch as our plans take shape.
text.text_3cb837d7fd48dfd7: Help build a theater for Hillsboro. Your gift supports the people and work that bring each show to life. Together, we can make something special.
text.text_5bf77db36932aa0d: Hillsboro Civic Theater is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. All donations are tax-deductible.
text.text_a4bfb3e85eff5e10: We are setting up a safe way to give. Online gifts are not available yet.
text.text_6cecff70c2fda7b0: HCT is just getting started. Help shape what comes next. We need sponsors, volunteers, performers, musicians, and partners of all kinds.
text.text_f9885a3e8a9a3f01: Tell us how you want to be part of this.
text.text_0f6fbc9ed9a797ce: A theater run by local volunteers. We bring big musicals to the stage with a full live orchestra.
text.text_e624eec0d33ee4c6: We put on big musicals with full live orchestras. We give each show the time and care it needs to shine.
text.text_dd58cddce8b5b909: Everyone on stage, in the orchestra, and behind the scenes is a volunteer. Our neighbors give their time to build and run HCT. They believe Hillsboro deserves great theater.
text.text_fb24df5d93668043: Have years on stage? Seeing your first show? Just want to help? There is a place for you here.
text.text_bb2aed03583f1eca: We welcome singers, actors, and dancers at every skill level. Our big musicals need lots of people on stage. Check here first for audition news.
text.text_b654fb26de357ca5: Live music is at the heart of our shows. Play strings, brass, woodwinds, or percussion? There is a place for your instrument in our orchestra.
text.text_3e5bb5237b34a576: Help lead our shows. We need directors, music directors, and dance leaders who care about great work and our community.
text.text_c5e9f23c1dce9557: Build sets, run lights and sound, make costumes, or manage the stage. The work behind the curtain matters as much as the show.
text.text_a6712cdf42809eea: Welcome guests, help at events, spread the word, or help with office tasks. There are many ways to lend a hand.
text.text_0fc6f1a9588e871a: Buy a ticket. Bring a friend. Tell someone about HCT. Every person in the audience helps make theater possible.
text.text_f44062bbbdb07374: Everyone belongs at HCT. On stage, in the orchestra, behind the scenes, or in the audience, you matter.
text.text_a5c64b86afc9be19: There is always more to learn. Whether this is your first show or you have years of practice, HCT is a place to grow.
text.text_aabe6402868aa44a: We care about the work. We practice until it feels right. We build with care. Each detail matters.
text.text_0ac73e9349a51f91: Theater should feel full of life. We love the work, the people, and the joy of a great show. That is why we are here.
text.text_45631ad9fcc9bffe: We are setting up HCT and doing the legal work. We are finding our first sponsors and volunteers.
text.text_ceaa387d1deb2002: We are bringing together our first cast, orchestra, directors, and crew. We are building ties with local venues and arts groups.
text.text_8d18c301e9c07e71: Our first big musical, with a full live orchestra and a local cast.
text.text_66d1bac29e89544e: Our goal: a season of shows each year, programs for young people, and a lasting home for the arts in Hillsboro.
text.text_b1e553e1ee7a1dfd: Every gift matters. Give what works for you. Your support helps us build HCT.
text.text_31a8f811e1362c4f: Your name in our first season program. Early news about tickets. Our heartfelt thanks.
text.text_1544326e4b64de9a: All Friend benefits. Thanks at HCT events. An invite to events just for Patrons.
text.text_ff8af5f805bb3ad5: All Patron benefits. Your name in show programs. A special thank-you at shows.
text.text_02b0b747a28d79c7: Help give HCT a lasting home in our city. Your name in all founding materials. A private thank-you event. Your name as part of our history.
text.text_a8f1f1c9e43a5941: Your name in the program, on our website, and on social media
text.text_58669665f830c9b9: All benefits above, plus your logo in the program and a spoken thank-you at shows
text.text_99b1e62a91a4bc02: All benefits above, plus a featured logo, an event invite, and thanks in press materials
text.text_d26df29237c7cfb0: All benefits above, plus your name tied to our first show and featured in all materials
text.text_8229a8b533835681: Your name honored as a founder. Title sponsor credit for our first season. A lasting place in HCT history.
text.text_05310a189251748c: “We are not trying to be Broadway. We are trying to be something more important: the theater that Hillsboro builds for itself.”
text.text_07b41c6ee762f415: “We've all felt it. That moment when the lights go down and the music begins.”
text.text_9b21136d3e4e757c: “The people who believe in this are the reason it will happen.”
text.text_58f3081d7977d6cf: “The kind of theater that stops time and reminds you what it feels like to be alive.”
